question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

**Logic : All the letters are arranged in descending order or immediate preceding letter order according to English alphabetic series.**

So,

 
• HGF

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c3e3fd44ce68bb4bf30be9df4447a68a9dc12abcec305be91cb678414eb6896.png] ​

 
• RQP

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c0f3ab3bc941c40707fd7220b1ce32a975e6eca0f97e2456fcc8004caa2f3d.png] 

 
• UVW

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3192ea66e7539ded8c822fb84b0c4757381ac6c1d2f522cdd1178b07154ac29d.png] 

 
• LKJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7d78c85e011dc9fae46c7353963ff98d33bf368cf2b57d921fd6610f0d67e54.png] 

Here, Only 'UVW' is not arranged in descending order or immediate preceding letter order.

Hence, **"UVW"** is the correct answer.

68:T82
